message.content: {"verdict":"FAIL","blockers":[{"field":"synthesis — Central insight","problem":"It recasts the 12-week time to launch as a 12-week deadline. The source says the initial request was for delivery in a matter of weeks, which the team found incompatible with a quality service; it does not say the team had a 12-week deadline.","outputQuote":"“Under a 12-week public-launch deadline”","evidenceLocation":"source","evidenceQuote":"“We were initially asked to deliver the service in a matter of weeks, which put huge pressure on everyone and we quickly discovered would not be possible if we wanted to create a quality service for our users.” The source separately says it “launched to the public in only 12 weeks.”","correction":"Describe the service as launching in 12 weeks, after an initial request to deliver in a matter of weeks."},{"field":"synthesis — What the narrative should emphasize","problem":"It attributes the account to “Nuëyon,” a name not supplied in the source, potentially misidentifying the author.","outputQuote":"“Nuëyon’s account of one product’s direction and working choices”","evidenceLocation":"source","evidenceQuote":"“I’m the Product Manager for the Power of Attorney (POA) refunds service for the Office of the Public Guardian (OPG).”","correction":"Replace “Nuëyon’s account” with “the author’s account.”"}]}
